provenance.scope: Full sourced Waste action cohort; generic overwrite body implemented in scratch patch, action/cost bindings explicitly pending.

subrules.name: 701.71a
subrules.rule: To waste a permanent means to create a continuous effect. The permanent's name is changed to Wastes, it becomes a basic land, gains “{T}: Add {C},” and loses all other supertypes, card types, subtypes, and abilities.

mechanics.original_reminder: It becomes Wastes, a basic land with “{T}: Add {C}” and no other abilities or types.

semantic_equivalence.evidence: Rule 701.71a overwrite is a single continuous effect setting name/types/supertypes, clearing all old subtype families and abilities, adding only the declared mana ability. Colors, counters, tappedness, controller and zone are unchanged. Arbitrary action operands, optional/group action scopes, conversion costs, discounts and completion events require independent structural readers; no whole-card equivalence certified.
